name: impeccable
api_description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
one_liner_zh: 设计词汇+critique/audit 审查+62 条确定性反 AI 味检测（无需 LLM）。
how_to_combine: 生成后与 ui_lint 并跑：`npx impeccable detect --json src/`；渲染相关规则要指向 dev server URL；结果按 rule 去重合并。
verification_scope: 仅核实 GitHub API 仓库元数据（stars/license/pushed_at）与 README；未安装运行，功能未实测。

name: hallmark
api_description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

how_to_combine: 借鉴分层：Floor=critical（对比/焦点/动效/手机布局不可破）、Reflex=major（可有理由豁免）、Finish=minor。
verification_scope: 仅核实 GitHub API 仓库元数据（stars/license/pushed_at）与 README；未安装运行，功能未实测。
